description: Player 2 deck for spec 31 (section 10.5, R17, R448). This is spec 03 player 2 deck (03-sheepish-b) with #41 Sheepish swapped for C #17 Counterspell and #1 Big D Fender swapped for #60 Bear Honeypot. These are the only two Traps in either deck. Bear Honeypot springs on any 1-cost card player 1 plays, so set beside Counterspell it is the trap a countered 1-cost Spell would have reached: R17 says a countered card reaches no other trap. Counterspell answers Spells only, so the Unit player 1 plays next is not countered and springs the Honeypot, which shows that the Honeypot was armed all along. Its seat plays under the handicap below, TUTORIAL_HUMAN's (R1705005): a human's resources with a deck of 20, the size every deck had before #1705, so these cards and the deal the spec's seed was tuned on stand. #5099: #8 Mr. Vanilla, #11 Tempo Timmy, #20 Pointmaster and #25 4-mana 7/7, a card whose whole text is its keyword line, are dealt as stand-ins (crates/engine/src/testkit/stand_in.rs) spelling their numbers as they stood, in the same place in the list, so the deal is unchanged and no balance patch moves them.
cards: stand-in (1) 3/3 Rush, First Strike R6/6 Charge, First Strike
